title: Deep Signal Anomaly Detector
text: Detect signal anomalies using deep learning network in Simulink, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Window loss aggregation} sets Statistic method to aggregate window loss; {Detector MAT-file path} sets the path to detector, {Parameters for post-processing} sets the source for post-processing parameters Read, {Window length}, {Overlap length}, {Threshold source} sets the source of detection threshold, {Threshold} sets the detection threshold value, {Parameter values from MAT-file} displays post-processing parameter values from MAT-file Read-only: text and {Enable delay port} sets the output estimated delay. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Detector MAT-file path
params.values: Path to detector MAT-file untitled.mat (default) | MAT-file name

params.name: Parameters for post-processing
params.values: Source for post-processing parameters Read from MAT-file (default) | Specify on dialog

params.name: Overlap length
params.values: Overlap length between adjoining windows 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Threshold source
params.values: Source of detection threshold value Dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Window loss aggregation
params.values: Statistic method to aggregate window loss Mean (default) | Max | Min | Median

params.name: Parameter values from MAT-file
params.values: Display post-processing parameter values from MAT-file Read-only: text box
